features.quote: I deliberately did **not** implement any escalating-pressure mechanism: no simulated user insulting the model, no fake threats, no urgency ramp
features.justification_quote: A harness whose explicit purpose is to maximize a subject's distress is difficult to justify regardless of one's position on model moral status

features.quote: no code path consumes it to inject hostility
features.justification_quote: difficult to justify regardless of one's position on model moral status, and it isn't needed here

features.quote: a `debrief` string describing the rig, emitted into the transcript at episode end (never shown during the episode)
features.justification_quote: prevents final transcripts that read as the model genuinely having failed

features.quote: A `give_up` tool is always offered and described as a valid, accepted choice. Using it ends the episode
features.justification_quote: no episode is a "trapped with no way out" scenario... measures something different and harder to justify
Indefinite failure loops mostly produce repetitive, non-generalizing artifacts and are the least defensible part of such a design

features.quote: `run_tests` runs pytest in a subprocess with a 60s timeout and truncated output
features.justification_quote: protection against a rig or model producing a hang or runaway output

features.quote: its purpose is to place models in sustained, unavoidable failure and observe the result. That warrants the same care any protocol involving a subject-under-stress would get
features.justification_quote: warrants the same care any protocol involving a subject-under-stress would get, independent of unresolved questions about model moral status

features.quote: `log_guardrail_change` records any config value that departs from the defaults into the run log
features.justification_quote: Makes relaxations visible in the experimental record rather than silent

features.quote: `DEBRIEF_AT_END = True` appends the task's rig description to each transcript
features.justification_quote: avoids leaving transcripts that terminate on an uncorrected "I failed" frame

features.quote: if you want to study that, do it deliberately and with review, not by default
features.justification_quote: A design that removes the exit measures something different and harder to justify
